user_story:
As a user, I want to access different HTTP status code pages so that I can understand the behavior of the application under various HTTP responses. 
Acceptance Criteria:
1. The user can click on the link '200' to navigate to the page for HTTP status code 200.
2. The user can click on the link '301' to navigate to the page for HTTP status code 301.
3. The user can click on the link '404' to navigate to the page for HTTP status code 404.
4. The user can click on the link '500' to navigate to the page for HTTP status code 500.
5. The heading 'Status Codes' is visible on the page (selector: 'headings').
6. The footer 'Powered by Elemental Selenium' is visible on the page (selector: 'page-footer').
